name: The Inheritor
desc:
The Inheritor is the protagonist of _Deepwoken'_s Vow of Iron gamemode. They are a member of the [Circle of Honour](faction:circle_of_honour).

Due to the threat posed by [The Lord Regent](entity:the_lord_regent) of [Etrea](faction:etrea) to the Eastern Luminant, the Inheritor was tasked by the [Reclaimer of the Recollection](entity:reclaimer_of_the_recollection) to use Mementos to relive the memories of those who had attempted to foil the Regent in the past in order to see if a weakness could be found.
